blocks.task_summary: Find expressions for a·c and b·c in terms of p.
method_path: Substitute vector components into scalar product formula a·c = a1*c1 + a2*c2
Substitute vector components into scalar product formula b·c = b1*c1 + b2*c2

evidence.basis: substituting into scalar product formula (M1) (i) (a·c =) 5p - 42 A1 (ii) (b·c =) 8p - 54 A1

blocks.task_summary: Find p such that the angle between a and c equals the angle between b and c.
method_path: Write cosθ = (a·c)/(|a||c|) using expression from (a)(i) and magnitudes
Write cosθ = (b·c)/(|b||c|) using expression from (a)(ii) and magnitudes
Equate the two expressions for cosθ
Solve the resulting equation for p

evidence.basis: substituting into the angle between two vectors formula to find either a·c or b·c (M1) cosθ = (5p-42)/(√74 √(p^2+36)), cosθ = (8p-54)/(√145 √(p^2+36)) (A1)(A1) equating their two expressions for cosθ (M1) p = 4.78727... (p =) 4.79 A1
